claims.statement: Polish prosumers currently pay for connected PV and storage systems partly to reduce purchased-energy costs; underperformance is a measurable loss against modeled savings.
A family installer can voluntarily provide access to a consented pilot workflow, while inverter telemetry remains controlled by homeowners, installers or vendors.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Installer owner, equipment distributor or commercial asset owner
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Independent cross-brand verification separates installer claims from manufacturer dashboards and ties findings to remediation.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own verification contracts; installers retain installation customers and asset owners retain telemetry rights.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Family installer pilot, then insurers, lenders and distributors that need independent post-install evidence.

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 2,000 PLN per installer or distributor account.
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Per-asset fee prepaid; monitoring subscription billed annually.
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 65-80% after telemetry connectors and analyst review.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Two hours setup and 30 minutes monthly exception review per commercial portfolio.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Security, telemetry agreements, liability insurance and accounting estimated at 6,000 PLN monthly at scale.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Commissioning verification fee plus monitoring subscription.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: API/connectivity, analyst review and occasional site-inspection partner.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Inverter vendors may improve analytics; independence and cross-brand remediation evidence are the wedge.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Customer pays for commissioning verification or monitoring when measured energy yield or storage behavior misses the contracted/modelled baseline.
commercial_mechanics.payer: Installer, commercial asset owner, lender or insurer
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Customer complaint, warranty dispute or portfolio acquisition.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual monitoring renewal and post-remediation reverification.

contrary_evidence: Vendor portals already expose production data.
Weather and household-load variance make savings attribution contentious.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Existing informal family operating relationship for permissioned pilot design; telemetry access requires separate owner consent and remains unacquired.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Use customer-exported files and partner with independent electricians; reject assets without lawful telemetry access.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Asset owners and equipment-platform vendors control telemetry; installers control their customer relationships.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own verification contracts; installers retain installation customers and asset owners retain telemetry rights.
critical_control_point.duration: Family operating relationship has no fixed duration.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Family-installer access supports pilot recruitment only; no telemetry or customer data is presumed granted.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control analysis methodology and verification contracts if launched.
critical_control_point.renewal: Mutual-consent pilot access; future telemetry consents and commercial contracts require explicit renewal terms.
critical_control_point.subject: Post-install performance-verification workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Verify 20 customer-consented systems against modeled baselines, price remediation value, then sell portfolio monitoring to distributors and lenders.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 25,000 monitored assets at 20 PLN monthly plus 2,000 annual verifications at 1,000 PLN creates 8M PLN revenue; at 20% owner earnings and 4x value, a 70% stake could exceed 5M PLN in years 7-10. Telemetry access and churn are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours weekly during analytics build; field work outsourced.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Fees less telemetry, analyst exception review and inspection partners; target 70%.
economics.payback: Customer payback depends on detecting at least 1,000-5,000 PLN of annual lost yield or avoiding a warranty dispute.
economics.pricing: 500-1,500 PLN commissioning check plus 15-40 PLN per asset monthly.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Continuous monitoring and annual savings verification.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned cross-brand fault signatures and remediation outcomes.
fingerprint.customer: PV and battery installers, portfolio owners, lenders and insurers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Installer pilots followed by distributor and finance partnerships.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Asset stakeholder pays at commissioning, dispute or annual monitoring renewal.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Observed yield shortfall or portfolio diligence.

risks: Telemetry APIs may be unavailable or unstable.
Residential willingness to pay may be low.

structure.control_point: Independent performance baseline and exception record

thesis: Use permissioned installer pilots to build an independent, cross-brand verification layer that monetizes measurable energy underperformance.
title: PV and Battery Yield Verification
uncertainties: Statistical separability of faults from weather and load
Which institutional payer values independence most
